description: Defines classes and interfaces for asynchronous file I/O operations within the disk cache component of Chromium, including File and FileIOCallback classes.

classes.name: FileIOCallback
classes.description: Interface for receiving completion notification of asynchronous file I/O operations.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Wrapper class for file operations supporting both synchronous and asynchronous I/O, with reference counting.

methods.name: OnFileIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of an asynchronous I/O operation, providing the number of bytes copied or an error indicator.

methods.name: File
methods.description: Constructor for File class, with options for mixed mode and initializing with an existing base::File.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the File object with a given file path.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file was successfully opened.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs synchronous or asynchronous read operations.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs synchronous or asynchronous write operations.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file, truncating or extending as needed.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the current length of the file.

methods.name: WaitForPendingIOForTesting
methods.description: Blocks until a specified number of pending I/O operations complete (testing utility).

methods.name: DropPendingIO
methods.description: Drops current pending I/O operations without waiting.

methods.name: platform_file
methods.description: Returns the underlying platform-specific file handle or descriptor.

methods.name: AsyncWrite
methods.description: Performs the actual asynchronous write operation.

methods.name: OnOperationComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous I/O operations.
